summary: Firefox now uses Skrifa, an open-source font library written in Rust, to read font data and metrics directly instead of relying entirely on platform APIs, improving consistency and performance. The font system was modernized through removal of feature flags for long-stable technologies like font-variations, and the CSS property `font-stretch` was renamed to the clearer `font-width` (with the old name kept as an alias). Various optimizations and thread-safety improvements were made to font caching and variable font handling.
